title: 第17章 药房里有干尸第18章 在拥挤的木箱里
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第17章药房里有干尸
“你就像是一个老鼠，莫扎利亚，你自己那边出了问题，还要连累到我们，没有将你赶走已经很客气了。”
在山寨子内，主大厅里，一位凶神恶煞的壮汉向一位穿戴着连帽长袍的男子投去了不屑的目光。
那男子的帽下有银丝垂落，抬起脑袋的那一刻，尖锐的猩红之瞳异常吓人。
就连坐在椅子上的壮汉也被这道目光吓了一跳。
是的，他就是莫扎利亚，变成了魔族并从牢房逃出的莫扎利亚这些天就待在这个地方。
“莫扎利亚，我警告你，我们同为女皇大人做事，你不能对我出手！”壮汉被莫扎利亚的目光吓得一身冷汗，自觉不是他的对手，只能出言警告。
“哼。”莫扎利亚不悦地哼了一声，深吸一口气后转身离开了大厅。
周围一群人紧张地注视着莫扎利亚，直到他的身影消失在众人的视线里，他们这才松一口气。
壮汉再招手示意手底下的人将大门关上，这才放松的靠在椅子上，调整好自己的坐姿。
“呵~不过一个侥幸的家伙，真以为有一个小爵位就了不起啊？等我送去一个大礼，我也能当贵族！”
“老大英明！”
“老大威武！”
“莫扎利亚算个屁啊！”
“他就是走个狗屎运的家伙！”
一众小弟不断出言附和，壮汉也乐的开心大笑。
可他们并不知道，只是因为地形落差大才不见踪迹的莫扎利亚并未走远，尖耳朵动一动就能清晰捕捉他们的声音。
莫扎利亚转过脑袋，露出极其不悦的表情，而后回首看向了某栋小屋……
他忽然发出了一声不屑的嗤笑，随后便向那栋小屋走去。
在小屋前，有几个人贩子正在说笑，忽然瞥到走来的莫扎利亚后立即露出了严肃的表情，假装自己并没有在摸鱼划水。
“莫扎利亚大人，这段期间药房没有进过无关人士，药物出入也按您的要求记录完备。”几个人贩子一同向莫扎利亚问好，并简单汇报自己的工作。
莫扎利亚满意得点了两下脑袋，随后忽然挥手——
滋——那一刻，这些人贩的脖颈忽然多了几道抓痕，鲜血也浮在了空中。
几个人面露惊惧的目光，他们不知道莫扎利亚为何要杀他们，更来不及问出口，他们的目光便已晦暗。
莫扎利亚拖着几人进入了药房，用魔法移动浮空的血液，足足五分钟才从药房里出来，并将门锁上。
完成这一切后，莫扎利亚很自然地离开了山寨。既然这里不欢迎他，那他自有其他去处。
而他刚走，姆莉三人就从侧面的小道来到了药房旁，恰好与莫扎利亚错开。
“这里就是药房，正门那边通常有几个人在看守，没有可以隐蔽的地方，姆莉你就躲在这后面吧。”辛西指着药房后的一棵大树道。
姆莉点头，她的身手不好，就只能在外给二人放风了。
接着，辛西又兴奋地看向了唐，按捺着心中的激动道：“骑士大人，请、请帮我上去，我先探探情况。”
唐点头，让辛西踩在自己的手上，送他扒住侧面的高窗。
辛西缓慢探出脑袋，却又在一瞬间缩回了头，全身都明显抖了两下。

Chapter 17 There are mummies in the pharmacy
"You are like a mouse, Mozalia. If you have a problem on your side, you will also implicate us. It is polite not to drive you away."
In the cottage, in the main hall, a fierce and strong man cast a disdainful look at a man wearing a hooded robe.
There was silver thread hanging down from under the man's hat, and the moment he raised his head, his sharp scarlet pupils were extremely scary.
Even the strong man sitting on the chair was startled by this look.
Yes, he is Mozalia. Mozalia, who became a demon and escaped from the cell, is staying in this place these days.
"Mozalia, I'm warning you, we are both working for the Queen, you can't attack me!" The strong man was frightened by Mozalia's gaze and broke into a cold sweat. He felt that he was no match for him, so he could only give a warning.
"Hmph." Mozalia snorted displeasedly, took a deep breath, turned and left the hall.
A group of people around him watched Mozalia nervously, and they breathed a sigh of relief until his figure disappeared from everyone's sight.
The strong man waved to the people under him to close the door, then relaxed and leaned on the chair, adjusting his sitting posture.
"Haha~ I'm just a lucky guy. Do you really think that having a small title is a big deal? When I give you a big gift, I can also become a noble!"
"The boss is wise!"
"Boss is mighty!"
"Mozalia is nothing!"
"He's just a lucky guy!"
The younger brothers kept echoing the words, and the strong man also laughed happily.
But they didn't know that Mozalia, who had disappeared only because of the large difference in terrain, had not gone far, and his pointed ears could clearly catch their voices.
Mozalia turned her head, showing an extremely unhappy expression, and then looked back at a certain hut...
He suddenly let out a disdainful sneer, and then walked towards the small house.
In front of the hut, several traffickers were joking. Suddenly they caught a glimpse of Mozalia approaching and immediately showed a serious expression, pretending that they were not fishing.
"Sir Mozalia, no unrelated persons have entered the pharmacy during this period, and the entry and exit of medicines are fully recorded according to your requirements." Several traffickers said hello to Mozalia and briefly reported on their work.
Mozalia nodded twice with satisfaction, and then suddenly waved——
Zhi——At that moment, the necks of these traffickers suddenly had a few scratches, and blood floated in the air.
Several people had frightened eyes on their faces. They didn't know why Mozalia wanted to kill them, and even before they had time to ask, their eyes were already dark.
Mozalia dragged several people into the pharmacy and used magic to move the floating blood. It took a full five minutes to come out of the pharmacy and lock the door.
After completing all this, Mozalia naturally left the mountain stronghold. Since he is not welcome here, he has other places to go.
As soon as he left, the three of them came to the pharmacy from the side path, just across from Mozalia.
"This is the pharmacy. There are usually several people guarding the front entrance. There is no place to hide. Muli, just hide behind here." Xinxi pointed to a big tree behind the pharmacy.
Muli nodded. Her skills were not good, so she could only show off to the two of them outside.
Then, Xinxi looked at Tang excitedly, suppressing the excitement in her heart and said: "Master Knight, please, please help me go up. I'll explore the situation first."
Tang nodded, let Xinxi step on his hand, and let him grab the high window on the side.
Xinxi slowly stuck out her head, but then retracted her head in an instant, and her whole body trembled obviously.
